tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam par thar pa dad gus kyi chu 'dzin rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rab 'byams chos kyi rje zhes/ yongs su grags pa'i mtshan gyis snyan pas/ nyi 'og gi rgyal khams mtha' dag khyab pa de'i rnam par thar pa/ dad gus kyi chu 'dzin rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun tshogs chos sku'i go 'phang rab brnyes pas/ /phun tshogs gzugs sku'i bkod pa sna tshogs ston/ /phun tshogs mchog sku mthong bas dang 'dren pa'i/ /phun tshogs sku gsum mthar phyin gang de rgyal/ /gsung rab legs bshad ma lus kun 'dus nas/ /gsung gi zer gyis 'gro ba'i snying mun sel/ /gsung mchog yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan pa'i/ /gsung gi dbang phyug bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /thugs rgyud byams dang snying rjes rab mdzes shing / /thugs kyi dgongs pa rmad byung mnga' ba'i mthus/ /thugs la bzhed pa'i 'gro don bsgrub mdzad pa'i/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rgya chen lung gi lha lam yangs pa der/ /rnam dag rigs pa'i sprin tshogs rab bsdus nas/ /man ngag bdud rtsi'i char rgyun rab 'bebs pa'i/ /lung rigs mnga' bdag bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bslab gsum rtogs pa'i rtsa ba rab tu brtan/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i yal 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'bras bu mchog stsol ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma dpag bsam dbang por 'dud/ /'dir bdag cag rnams kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i mgon skyabs dam par gyur pa 'di nyid/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phan bde'i phrin las kyi ngo bo gdul bya yongs kyi don du dge ba'i bshes gnyen du sku sprul te/

yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i rgyal srid mtha' dag la mnga' mdzad nas/ bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i khrims gnyis kyi mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ thub pa'i dbang po'i lung rtogs kyi rgyal sa mdzes par byed pas na/ chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba chen po zhes kyang bya'o/ /rgyu 'bras nad kyi zug rngus lus sems sdug bsngal bar gyur ba'i 'khor ba pa rnams la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi zag med kyi bde ba phun sum tshogs pa stsol bar mdzad pas na/ sman pa'i rgyal po bla na med pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol tu 'gro bar 'dod pa rnams thar pa'i gling du bde blag tu 'khrid par byed pas na/ ded dpon bla na med pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /bdag dang bdag gir lta ba'i ling tog mthug pos blo gros kyi mig long ste/ phyin ci log gi g.yang sa gom pa chas pa rnams yang dag pa'i lam la bkri bar mdzad pa'i sgo nas/ rnam grol mchog gi grong khyer du phyin par byed pas na/ sa mkhan bla na med pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /sems rgyud dam pa'i chos kyis phongs shing yon tan gyi 'byor pa dang bral ba rnams la/ lung rtogs kyi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa sbyin par byed pas na/ chos kyi sbyin bdag chen po zhes kyang bya'o/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas legs par gsungs pa'i mdo sde dang / rgyud sde dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa ma lus pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur cing / 'dzam gling mkhas pa kun gyis bsten pa'i gnas su gyur pas na/ rgya bod kyi gsung rab mtha' dag gi glegs bam gcig po zhes kyang bya'o/ /mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge legs ma lus pa bskrun par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid/ sa'i gzhi la 'gran zla ma mchis pa rje btsun bla ma dam pa de'i rnam par thar pa ji lta ba ni dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams dang dbyer ma mchis pas na/

su zhig gis brjod par spobs/ 'on kyang gdul bya tha mal pa rnams la ji ltar snang ba'i tshul las che long tsam zhig brjod par bya'o/ /de yang rgyal ba nyid kyi zhal snga nas nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong dang lnga brgya 'das pa na/ byang phyogs nas byang phyogs gdong dmar can gyi yul du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bka' stsal ba de nyid dus la bab par dgongs te/ ji skad du/ 'phags pa'i spyod yul thob pa gang / /byis pa'i spyod yul du bstan te/ /de nyid phyir na 'gro ba yi/ /gnyen gyi thabs dang snying rje mchog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phan bde'i phrin las dge ba'i bshes gnyen du skye ba sprul sku'i tshul bstan pa/ rab 'byams chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam par thar pa la/ sdom tshig dang / de'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bltams dang khrims mnos sbyang dang mkhas/ /'pho dang bstan pa spel tshul drug /rab 'byams ches rje'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /legs par bshad bya gus par rigs/ /gnyis pa la/ sdom tshig ltar/ don drug ste/ kun gyi bkur gnas su gyur pa'i slad du cho rigs btsun por sku 'khrus pa'i tshul/ rang smin nas gzhan rjes su gzung ba'i slad du bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshul khrims ji ltar nod pa'i tshul/ dam pa rnams dang mthun par bstan nas gzhan smin par bya ba'i slad du yongs su 'dzin pa bstan nas sbyangs pa mdzad pa'i tshul/ mkhas pa'i go 'phangs brnyes nas thub pa'i rgyal srid gzung ba'i slad du 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa spel tshul/ rtag 'dzin bzlog nas 'phrad dka'i 'du shes skyed pa'i slad du sku'i 'pho ba bstan tshul/ gdul bya'i khams brtags nas mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i slad du bstan pa rgyun du gnas pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la/ gang du sku 'khrungs pa'i gnas/ gang gis bskyed pa'i yab yum/ brgyud gang du 'khrungs pa'i rigs rus/

rigs der 'khrungs pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ yongs su grags pa'i mkhas grub chen po du ma sku 'khrungs shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i rong gi sa'i cha/ phun sum tshogs pa mtha' dag brkyang zhing bsnar ba lta bur gyur pa bsnar rdo be zhes bya bar sku bltams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ yab skyes pa'i yon tan du mas brgyan pa/ dpon smin drug bzang zhes bya ba dang / yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i mtshan rtags can/ dus gsum gyi rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs shing / rgyal ba bskyed pa'i dngos grub thob pa/ mtshan yang byin rlabs dngos grub tu grags pa la/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba zhig rang gi lus la thim pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul gyi ltas du ma dang lhan cig yum bde ba'i khyad par dang bcas pa'i ngang nas/ lcags mo yos kyi lo la bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma'i dpal dang ldan par sku 'khrungs pa las/ sku mched bzhi yod pa'i bdag nyid chen po 'di tshigs gnyis pa yin la/ dus de nyid nas yab yum sku'i dbon po dang bcas pa rnams dpal 'byor je mthor gyur pa yin zhes thos so/ /gsum pa ni/ kha ba can gyi zhing khams 'di 'dul ba'i slad du/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku'i sprul pa/ srong btsan sgam po'i chos kyi don ma lus par bsgrub pa'i nang blon 'gar rig pa can zhes grags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa de'i rgyud du sku 'khrungs shing / sku rtsed kyi rnam pas gdung rus 'di'i kha 'dzin yang legs par mdzad/ nged tsho'i brgyud pa 'di la khyim na gnas na ma sangs dang / ded dpon yong / mtshal pa khri dpon la sogs nged tsho'i brgyud pa yin/ khyim spangs te rab tu byung na mkhas grub 'byung / rong pa 'gar dge la sogs nged tsho'i brgyud pa yin gsung ngo / /bzhi pa rigs der 'khrungs pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par ni/ sku'i yon tan/ dbu gdugs ltar rgyas pa sogs mtshan dpe phal cher gsal por mnga'/

gsung gi yon tan ji skad du/ rgyas sras tshig ni mi zhan pa/ /snyan cing legs bshad grags pa dang / /ci rigs pa dang zang zing med/ /ran cing de bzhin yangs pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar yan lag brgyad kyi yon tan mnga' ba'o/ /thugs mkhyen brtse'i yon tan ni/ sku nas phra mo'i dus nyid nas/ rang bzhin gyis dbang po rno ba/ blo gsal zhing yid gzhungs pa/ blang dor gyi bdag rigs rab tu phyed pas spang blang ma 'dzol ba/ khong 'dzangs shis/ ya rabs pas gzhan gyi sems bsrung ba dang / mgu bar byed pa'i thabs la rab tu brtson pa/ mngon par shes pa thol byung du smra ba la/ pha mas kyang yid brtan bcas te spang blang bgyis pas bya ba gang dang gang la yang / thal song dang nor 'phyug mi yong ba dang / khyad par skye ba dpag tu med pa nas chos la goms pa'i ngang tshul can yin pas/ rab tu byung ba thos bsam mdzad pa gzigs nas/ de la thugs yid chags nas 'bral mi phod pas/ bkres skom kyang mi dran par de'i drung du gnas pa zhig yod do zhes gsung las thos shing / klog yig sogs kyang 'bad pa chung ngus kun chub par mdzad do/ /ji skad du/ gdod nas goms pa'i dge tshogs shar ri'i rtser/ /smon lam rta bdun gyis drangs nyi gzhon zhig /dge legs phan bde'i 'od zer 'bum ldan 'di/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du shar/ /gnyis pa rang smin nas gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i slad du/ yon tan gyi rtsa ba tshul khrims ji ltar nos pa'i tshul la/ nges 'byung so thar gyi tshul khrims ji ltar nos pa'i tshul/ gzhan phan byang sems kyi tshul khrims ji ltar nos pa'i tshul/ thabs chen rig 'dzin gyi tshul khrims ji ltar nos pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la/ tshig snga ma gnyis bsnos pa'i tshul dang / phyi ma bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni bdag nyid chen po dgung lo bdun bzhes pa'i tshe/ chos dang 'brel ba'i zhabs tog lhag par che ba/ kho bo dad pa'i mtshan can gyis/

dpal chos 'khor sgang gi gdan sa chen por spyan drangs te/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i dbus na bslab gsum nor bus mdzes pa mkhan chen rin po che seng ge rgyal mtshan pa dang / slob dpon nam mkha' 'od zer la sogs pa/ rigs grol 'dus pa'i dbus su/ dge bsnyen dang / dge tshul gyi bslab pa legs par mnos/ thugs dgyes spro chen po dang ldan pas gces par bskyangs shing gsan sbyong kyang ci rigs pa gnang ngo / /ji skad du/ sku yi lhun po gur gum skyengs byed bzhin/ /dmar por mdangs ldan chos gos sprin gyis klubs/ /thugs kyi lhun po gangs ri skyangs byed bzhin/ /rab dkar tshul khrims dpal gyis byug par gyur/ /gnyis pa ni/ sku'i lang tsho nyes med phun tshogs kyis nar son cing dus la bab pa na/ rdo rje theg pa mtha' dag gi 'byung khungs nub phyogs u rgyan dang dbyer ma mchis pa/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi chos grwa chen por phyag phebs te/ rigs ma lus pa'i khyab bdag chen po rdo rje 'chang de nyid/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin par sku sprul nas/ skal ba dang 'tsham par gdul bya rnams sdom pa gsum gyi khrims la 'god pa'i bka' drin stsol ba la mkhas shing / zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i snod du 'os pa rnams la/ rgyud sde mtha' dag gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bang mdzod kyi sgo phyes te/ smin par byed pa'i dbang bzhi/ grol bar byed pa'i lam rim pa gnyis la sogs pa 'dod dgu'i dga' ston gyis tha mal snang zhen gyi 'khrul pa thams cad lhag pa'i lha dang / dag pa'i zhing du 'char ba'i sa la 'god pas/ rdo rje theg pa mtha' dag gi mnga' bdag tu bzhugs la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ma lus pa la thugs rang dbang du gyur pas/ byang sems kyi spyod pa rlabs po che lhur bzhes pa la byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po ltar/ zab cing yangs la gting dpag dka' ba'i spyod pa can/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i pha rol du phyin pas/

so so thar pa'i brtul zhugs mchog gi gces spras la ni/ dgra bcom pa nye bar 'khor dang / 'phags pa rta thul ltar bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba phra mo'i phra mos kyang ma gos par bzhugs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag mkhas grub mtha' dag gi gtsug rgyan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mkhan po/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i lung rtogs kyi yon tan du ma'i dpal 'byor mnga' zhing / byang sems kyi spyod pa mchog la gcig tu gzhol ba sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis las kyi slob dpon dang gsang ston gnyis ka mdzad/ mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag mkhan chen kha char par grags pas dus bsgo ba mdzad/ mdo sde dang / rgyud sde dang rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin te/ mngon spyod la sogs pa'i phrin las bzhi la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ chos rje gzhon nu seng ge ba sogs dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus na bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po brnyes par mdzad do/ /nam zhig brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan par phebs pa'i tshe/ thabs des gzhan rjes su bzung ba'i tshul ni/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang gsum zhes grags pa'i sa yi khyon mtha' dag nas lhag pa'i gdul bya so sos bdag nyid chen po 'di la/ so thar gyi bka' drin thob pa'i dge slong / dge tshul/ dge bsnyen la sogs pa'i khrims ldan ni/ sa chen po'i rdul ltar rab tu grangs mang bar bzhugs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa/ gzhan phan byang sems kyi tshul khrims ji ltar nos pa'i tshul ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod mtha' dag gi bcud kyi snying po/ smon 'jug gi sdom pa yang / mkhan rin po che rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po nyid kyi drung du/ shing rta'i srol chen gnyis las 'ongs pa'i cho ga'i khyad par mi 'dra ba dbu sems su grags pa gnyis char gsan nas/

thabs des gzhan rjes su bzung ba'i tshul yang / gdul bya'i tshogs brgya phrag mang po la yang dang yang du gnang bas rin po che 'di las sems kyi sdom pa dang blo sbyong gi 'khrid la sogs pa'i bka' drin thob nas/ nyams su len pa yang grangs las 'das pa bzhugs pa yin no/ /gsum pa thabs chen rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshul khrims ji ltar nos pa'i tshul ni/ thog mar mkhas grub chen po kun dga' bzang po'i drung du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga la sogs dkyil 'khor du/ smin byed kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par gsan te/ de'i grol byed kyi lam rim pa gnyis/ rdzogs rim zab mo spros med kyi 'khrid/ nyams 'khrid du gsan nas mkhyen rab kyi khang bzang zab don bskyed rdzogs kyi mtshon ris mchog tu bkra ba'i dag snang dang ma bral bar/ rdo rje theg pa'i brtul zhugs mchog la dbang 'byor bar bzhugs pa yin no/ /thabs des gdul bya gzhan rjes su bzung ba'i tshul yang / skal ldan gyi gdul bya grangs mang po la/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ gshin rje gshed skor/ ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog dgyes pa rdo rje la sogs pa'i smin byed dbang gi chu rgyun gyis tha mal snang zhen gyi 'khrul ba'i dri ma mtha' dag bkrus te/ lam 'bras/ spros med/ ni gu chos drug la sogs pa/ zab rgyas 'khrid kyi dga' ston rgya chen po stsal te/ gdul bya so so'i blo gros kyi bum bzang zab don rtogs pa'i bcud kyis legs par gang bar mdzad pa yin no/ /des na bdag nyid chen po 'di ni/ sdom pa gsum gyi phyogs la/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyi go cha btsan po dang skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar gnas pas/ nyes ltung phra mo'i phra mo las rgyang ring du gyur cing / bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa'i sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims kyi mtshon cha rnon pos/ srid zhi gnyis kyi rgud pa mtha' dag las rnam par rgyal ba dang /

dge ba'i chos mtha' dag bsdud pa'i tshul khrims dang / thabs chen rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshul khrims gnyis kyis rnam par grol bar mchog gi yon tan rin po che'i rgyal srid la dbang du gyur te/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa mthar phyin pa'i sgo nas/ btsun pa la 'gran zla med par bzhugs pa yin no/ /ji skad du/ nges 'byung tshul khrims shel gyi mchod rten mchog /gzhan phan lhur len byang sems mtshon gyis mdzes/ /thabs chen rig 'dzin rgyan gyis rab tu brjid/ /skal bzang dang ldan lha mi'i sti stangs gnas/ /gang gi dad brtson tsha zer rgyas pa yis/ /mkhas grub mkhan slob gangs ri zhu ba las/ /rnyog bral tshul khrims chu klung 'bum phrag gis/ /mkhyen rab ma dros rgya mtsho gang bar gyur/ /chu gter de las slar yang chu chen bzhi/ /grangs med mtshams las rgal ba gdul bya yi/ /zhing gis dpal du babs pas rnam grol gyi/ /'bras bu mtha' dag rgyas pa'i dge legs bsgrubs/ /gsum pa yongs 'dzin bsten nas sbyangs pa mdzad tshul la/ dul ba lhur len pa nang gi gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa'i tshul/ mkhas pa lhur len pa phyi'i gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa'i tshul/ de dag gi don thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la/ rgya chen pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyangs pa'i tshul dang / zab don sngags la sbyangs pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la/ 'chad byed dgongs 'grel la sbyangs pa'i tshul dang / bshad bya bka' la sbyangs pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la/ gang la ji ltar gsan pa'i tshul dang / mkhyen nas bstan pa gsal phyir grags pa spel tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gang la thos bsam bya ba'i yul de dag kyang / rgya chen spyod pa'i phyogs dang / mtha' bral lta ba'i phyogs gnyis su 'dus pa las/ ci rigs par gsan pa'i go rim dang sbyar nas 'chad do/ /de yang sku na phra mo'i dus su/ lung rtogs du mas brgyan pa/ stag tshang pa sangs rgyas dpal pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa zhib tu gsan pas 'di yi rnam spyod kyi mthu thogs pa med pa'i rtsal gyis/

tshig don rnams myur du kun chub par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal ba'i dbang po ma pham pa dang / 'phags pa ngag gi dbang phyug chos kyi 'gro ba mdzad pa'i tshul gyis byin gyis brlabs pas/ mkhas grub ma lus pa'i byung khungs/ dpal rdo rje gdan gnyis pa gsang phu ne'u thog gi chos grwa chen por phyag phebs te/ dri med lung rigs kyi bang mdzod/ shangs ston mkhas pa rin chen grub la/ dgung lo bcu gsum tsam bzhes pa'i dus su/ bka' bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa gsan cing / dgung lo bcu bdun bco brgyad kyi dus su/ bka' bcu yongs su rdzogs pa gsan nas/ grwa skor yang mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe bdag nyid chen po 'di lang 'tsho'i dkyil 'khor rab tu gzhon na yang / mkhyen rab tsha zer lhag par rgyas pa'i sgo nas/ rnam dag rig pa'i tsha zer gzhan gyis bzod par mi nus pa'i spobs pa mnga' bas/ 'di yi rig pa'i me lce rnon pos/ lta grub ngan pa'i tshang tshing mtha' dag bsregs nas/ rgol ba mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin du 'jug pa'i tshul des mkhas pa rnams yid phrogs te/ bdag nyid chen po gang du rtsod pa'i grwa der thams cad 'dus nas/ e ma ho/ 'di 'dra ba'i mkhas pa su zhig go zer ba sogs/ ngo mtshar gyi bsngags pa phan tshun gcig la gcig gleng zhing sgrog pa dang / 'di yis mkhyen rab kyi nam mkha' las 'ongs pa'i rig pa'i gnam lcags de dag mkhas pa rnams kyi gces spras su 'chang zhing / dus de nyid nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtsod pa rnam par dag pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /skabs der rgyal ba shākya seng ge'i bstan pa'i khang bzang gang gi bshad sgrub kyi rgyal mtshan/ mngon par mtho bas mdzes par byed pa'i mkhas grub chen po shar rgyal mo rong pa de'i mkhyen brtse'i spyan zur gyis nye bar 'tsho zhing bskyangs te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa mang po zhig gi bka' babs brnyes nas/

dgongs don yid bzhin nor bu'i dpal la dbang 'byor mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas zab yangs shes bya'i nam mkha' la/ mtha' yas yon tan gyi rgyu skar bye bas bkra ba'i dpal mnga' ba/ chos kyi rje rong chung shes rab dpal ba'i drung du'ang / rje btsun byams pa'i chos lnga dang / mngon pa sogs mang po zhig gsan zhing mkhyen par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang mkhas grub dge ba'i mtshan can la/ dngos stobs rig pa'i gzhung la sogs pa mang po dang / yon tan rol mtsho'i dbus na grub pa gser ris skor ba chos kyi rje don yod dpal ba la/ mngon pa dang 'brel ba'i phar phyin gyi bka' gnas phran tshegs kyang gsan no/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i dbus nas rlabs chen spyod pa'i gdengs kas brjid pa/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu bo/ bdag pas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po ches 'gro ba ma lus pa bdag tu mdzad nas/ phan bde mchog la 'god par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa'i drung du/ rgyal ba'i yum stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa la sogs pa'i gsung rab rgya che ba gsan zhing thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /de'i dus sku na phra yang mkhas grags che bas/ chos grwa byams chen gyi mkhan slob sogs/ bka' nan che ba dang / sku nye rnams kyi blo brid pa'i ngor/ dge rgyas grwa tshang gi slob dpon du bsko bzhag tsam yang zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de nas rgya chen thos pas mi ngom pa'i byang sems kyi spyod pa spyad pa'i slad du/ mkhyenaṃ rabaṃ kyi nam mkha' pha mtha' yangs pa'i khyon la/ lung rtogs nyi zla zung gis bgrod pa thogs pa med pas/ thub bstan gling bzhi gsal bar mdzad pa'i dbangaṃ phyugaṃ ces/ rab snyan grags pa'i ba dan dkar po skal bzang rna ba'i dpal du g.yo bas mkhas pa chen po de'i phrin las kyi dri bsung zhim pos/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i thugs yid 'phrogs te/ mkhas pa de'i chos kyi mdun sar phebs nas/

sngar gsan pa dang / ma gsan pa'i gzhung lugs phra rags bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsan te/ dgung lo bcu gsum gyi bar du bzhugs nas/ tshig dang don gyi cha la 'khrul pa'i sgro skur med par mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /slar yang bstan pa 'ba' zhig la dgongs pa'i lhag bsam can 'dis/ 'dul 'dzi rgyu skar gyi dbus na nyes ltung phra mo'i nag nog mi mnga' zhing / legs bshad 'od dkar 'phro bas thub bstan ku mud kyi tshal mdzes par mdzad pa dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen pa'i drung du/ 'dul mdzod lung sde bzhi dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gsan zhing / de yang rje mkhyen rab dbang phyug gi drung du/ 'dul ba tshar bcu gnyis gsan pa las rtogs pa 'phel rgyu cher mi 'dug na'ang / ding sang gi dus su dmar ston pa 'dul ba'i bdag por grags 'dug pas/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba 'di la gzhan phan phrin las rgya chen po yongs la re phyin pa yin gsung ngo / /gnyis pa bstan pa gsal phyir snyan grags spel ba'i tshul la/ mkhas pas bsngags pa'i grwa skor ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul dang / de ltar mdzad pa'i dgos pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thog mar phar tshad 'dul mdzod bzhi'i tshig don legs par dgongs nas/ dgung lo bcu bzhi pa la/ dpal mngon dga'i chos grwa mkhas mang 'dus pa'i dbus su/ rab brjid mkhyen rab kyi gangs ri las/ legs par bshad pa'i chu klung ci yang phab pas/ de'i mkhas pa blo gros yangs par rlom pa'i bgres po rnams kyang / khengs pa'i khur bor te/ 'di yi mkhyen rab kyi mthu la ches ngo mtshar du gyur cing / mtshan yang kyog po bka' bzhi par grags te/ dus de nyid nas bstan pa rin po che la phan pa rgya chen po mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas slar yang gsang phur phyag phebs te/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa'i dus su/ gzhung lugs chen po po ti bcu skor gyi tshig don mtha' dag kun chub par mdzad nas rtse thang dang / gnyal la sogs pa'i dbus phyogs su gra sa phal che ba'i mkhas mang 'dus pa'i grwar legs par bshad pa'i chos kyi dga' ston rgya cher mdzad pas/

mkhas pa thams cad kyi yid phrogs te/ ches cher bsngags shing / gsang phu'i chos lung spyi khang du bzhugs pa gnang bas/ mtshan yang chos lung bka' bcu par grags shing / thub bstan rin po che'i zhabs tog tu che ba mdzad do/ /de nas dgung lo bcu dgu pa la/ rje mkhyen rab dbang phyug pa'i grwa sar phyag phebs te/ lo bcu'i bar du gsung rab rgya che ba la gsan sbyong mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /dgung lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa la/ rgya bod na gzhung lugs chen por grags pa po ti bzhi bcu rtsa lngas gtso byas pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams kyi tshig dang don gyi cha phra mo tsam la yang / rgya bod kyi 'grel pa 'grel bshad dang bcas pa'i 'grel tshul dang / 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa rnams so sor phye ste/ 'di dang 'di'o zhes 'chad pa la 'jigs pa dang bral ba'i spobs pa'i dpal thob nas/ thog mar gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar/ dar gdugs kyi bsu ba dang bcas te phyag phebs pa nas/ mkhas mang 'bum phrag 'tshogs pa'i dbus su/ legs par bshad pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag la/ tshig don 'khrul pa med pa'i dga' ston rgya chen mdzad pas/ mkhas pa de dag gi nga rgyal dang khengs pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs nas/ ngo mtshar dang ya mtshan gyi dga' spro ci yang rgyas par mdzad de/ dpal mkhas pa'i dbang po byams chen rab 'byams pa zhes snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs kun khyab par gyur to/ /de'i tshe phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che stobs kyis 'dzin pa la 'gran pa'i zla ma mchis pa/ chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog legs pa'i chos grwa chen po dpal ngam rings su'ang / grwa skor la phyag phebs par 'dug go /zhes sa skyong des gsan nas/ rang gi bka' spyi bos len pa'i sa'i gzhi la pho nya bkram ste/ rgya chen po'i gzhung lugs la goms 'dris yod pa dang / ston pa dang rtsod pa bzang bar grags pa thams cad bsdus nas/

bdag nyid chen po 'di la/ brtsad cing dri ba la sogs pa'i sta gon gyi thugs rtsol chen po mdzad do/ /de nas mtshungs med smra ba'i zla ba 'dis/ mkhas mang rgyu skar tshogs pa'i grwa sa dpal ngam rings kyi chos sde chen por phyag phebs te/ gzhung lug chen po de dag la/ rang lugs dang / gzhan lugs rnam par phye ba'i bshad pa dang / dgag sgrub kyi 'od dkar grangs med pa spros pas/ mkhas mang 'dus pa'i skar tshogs de dag gi rlom dregs 'od kyi snang ba mi mngon par byas nas/ 'gran zla med par dad pa dang ya mtshan gyi bsam gtan bsgom pa la sbyar te/ dus de nyid nas mkhas pa mkhas pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su bgrang ba la/ 'gran zla med par byang phyogs gangs ris skor ba'i rgyud 'dir/ bka' rab 'byams pa bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba zhes/ rab snyan grags pa'i sprin gyi rnga sgras tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las kyang 'das par bzhugs pa yin no/ /ji skad du/ 'di yi mkhyen pa'i ting mtha' tshol 'dod pa/ /de yis rang gi ngang tshul gsal bar byas/ /nam mkha'i pha mtha' mthong bar 'dod pa yi/ /bung bas gshog stobs bskyed pa ji bzhin no/ /gnyis pa snyan grags spel ba'i dgos pa ni/ spyir rlom dregs kyi nga rgyal dang / rnyed grags la sred pa'i chos brgyad kyi bsam pas kun nas bslang ba'i grwa skor ni mkhas pa rnams kyis rgyang ring du spang dgos la/ bdag nyid chen po 'di yis/ grwa sa chen po rnams su grwa skor mdzad pa'i dgos pa ni/ grwa sa de dang der bzhugs pa'i mkhas pa rnams la ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gyi dri ma bsal te/ gsung rab mtha' dag la blo gros thogs med du rgyas pa'i ched dang / skal ldan gyi gdul bya grangs med pa 'khor du bsdus nas/ khyad par gyi chos lnga dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa'i ched kho nar grwa skor mdzad pa yin no/ /khyad par lnga ni/

ji lta ba dang / ji snyed pa gsal bar gzigs pa'i blo gros bzang po/ dka' spyad log sgrub la skyo ba med pa'i snying stobs/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba'i snying rje/ shes bya thams cad la mkhas shing mkhas pa ltar gyi snyan pa'i grags pas kun la khyab pa/ gdul bya gang la thabs gang gis ji ltar 'chad pa'i cho ga bzang po shes pa dag yin te/ de skad du/ rje btsun gyi zhal snga nas/ de ltar blo bzang skyo ba med ldan brtse ba can/ /snyan pa rab grags cho ga bzang shes ldan pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' legs par smra ba yin pa ste/ /bshad pas skye bo'i nang na nyi ma bzhin du bltams/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa bshad bya bka' gsan pa'i tshul ni/ 'khor lo dang po lung sde bzhi dang / bar pa sher phyogs kyi mdo ni sngar gsan pa ltar yin zhing / gzhan yang bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gis/ skal bzang rnams la chos kyi dga' ston rlabs po che skye bar bya'o dgongs te/ rgya chen lung gi chu gter nyams rtogs yid bzhin nor bus gang ba'i/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po chos rje bka' 'gyur ba spyan drangs te/ yongs su rdzogs pa gsan nas/ legs par dgongs shing thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /ji skad du/ gang yang khyod kyi mkhyen rab 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /mkhas mang nyi ma'i zer gyis phye ba las/ /zab don sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyis yongs su gang / /legs bshad dri bsung 'dzum mdangs ci yang g.yo/ /chu la gnas pa'i 'o ma ngang pas 'byed/ /pad tshal sbrang rtsi'i bcud ni bung bas myang / /rab brjid nyi zla'i dpal ni nam mkhas 'dzin/ /bden gnyis zab mo'i bcud ni khyod kyis 'thungs/ /mi shes sgrib pa'i rnyog pa dang bral ba'i/ /gang gi mkhyen rab chu gter yangs pa la/ /legs bshad dgongs don gzugs brnyan ma lus pa/ /ma nor ji bzhin gsal bar 'phos par gyur/ /de ltar lung rigs chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las/

/legs bshad rnam spyod klog 'phreng g.yo ba can/ /rab snyan grags pa'i 'brug sgra zab mo ni/ /ngang gis g.yo ba shes bya'i gnas tshul yin/ /gnyis pa zab pa sngags kyi theg pa la sbyang tshul la/ gang la ji ltar gsan pa'i tshul dang / mkhyen nas gzhan la bshad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rgyud bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i lung dang / rgyud 'ga' zung gi bshad pa dang bcas pa/ rgyud sde mtha' dag gi mnga' bdag sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du gsan cing / 'chad byed dgongs 'grel la/ rgyud sde'i rim pa dang / smin grol gyi rim pa la sogs pa mang du yod kyang / ci rigs par gsan pa'i rim pa dang sbyar nas 'chad do/ /de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di/ sku skye ba dpag tu med pa nas chos la goms shing / khyad par sku skye ba snga ma 'di/ spyir gsang bsngags dang / bye brag 'khor lo bde mchog la mkhas pa'i mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇa chen mkhas pa zhig yin kyang / mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gyis cung zad dregs pas sku tshe 'di la/ bde mchog las phrin las chen po ma byung pa yin zhes/ lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dag gis brtag pa mdzad pa la shar ro/ /des na sku na phra mo'i dus su bag chags kyi dbang gis gsang sngags phyogs mang po zhig gsan par nges kyang / de'i dus kyi gsan yig mi snang bas/ 'dir ma spros so/ /phyis kyi gsan yig dang sgo bstun nas rags rim tsam brjod na/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i drung du sngar bshad pa ltar/ pha rgyud kyi skor mang rab gsan shing / rgyal ba de'i rgyal tshab chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du/ rtsa rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ 'grel chen sgron gsal/ mtha' drug rab gsal dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa/ sgrub thabs mdo bcas/ mde bsre/ rnam bzhag rim pa gsum dang sbyar ba'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa/ zung 'jug gsal ba/ dkyil chog nyi shu pa dang sbyar ba'i dkyil chog gi bshad pa/

rdzogs rim rim lnga man ngag zhal shes dang bcas pa/ de'i rgyab chos spyod bsdus sgron me'i bshad pa/ thams cad la thun mong du nye bar mkho ba/ 'gos kyi stong thun chen mo rnams gsan zhing / yang gshin rje gshed skor gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi bshad pa/ kyai rdo rje lugs bzhi rgyud dang bcas pa/ bde mchog lo nag dril gsum rtsa rgyud dang bcas pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang thun mong du snang ba gsum gyi khrid/ mdo sngags mtshams sbyor bar byed pa theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed/ dam tshig ma thob pa thob par byed pa kyai rdor yab kyi dbang bka' dang yum gyi dbang bka'/ dam tshig la gces spras su byed pa'i thabs rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa'i bshad pa/ dbang dus su thob pa'i lta ba gong 'phel du byed pa 'khor 'das dbyer med/ snang ba lhar 'char ba'i thabs bskyed rim gyi bshad pa/ de'i dmigs pa dang bcas pa/ lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa'i nyams len rgyun chags su byed pa'i thabs lam dus kyi dbang / lus dkyil gyi bshad pa dang bcas pa/ byin rlabs kyi rgyud pa ma nyams pa'i yan lag tu bdag med ma'i byin rlabs/ gsang dbang gi lam rlung dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor/ dbang gsum pa'i lam/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lam/ bzhi pa'i lam/ rdo rje rba rlabs kyi lam gyi khrid yongs su rdzogs pa dang / de dag gi gzhung bshad gnyag ma/ de las 'phros pa'i lam 'bras kyi chos sna drug cu rtsa bzhi/ rdo rje tshig rkang gi rgya cher bshad pa gzhung bshad sras don la/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇa chen gyi gsung sgros/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po'i zin bris su bkod pa'i gzhung bshad dmar ma/ rje bla mas mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad pod nag ma/ thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag pod dmar ma sogs/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i cha lag yongs su rdzogs pa/ klu grub kyi mchod rten drung thob/ pad+ma badz+ra gyi rdzogs rim mar me'i rtse mo/

grub chen tog rtse ba'i bsam gyis mi khyab/ ngag dbang grags pa'i phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa/ nag po spyod pa'i gtum mo lam rdzogs dang / yon po bsang ba'i man ngag ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka'i lhan cig skyes sgrub/ in+d+ra bo dhi'i kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan te lam skor phyi ma brgyad po 'di'i byin rlabs/ 'khrid/ man ngag dang bcas pa/ bde mchog rim lnga/ nag po rim bzhi/ bde mchog dkar po'i 'khrid/ rtsa dbu ma sogs man ngag zhal shes la sogs la ma lus pa dang / bsnyen pa rgyas pa dang sbyar ba'i rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bshad pa/ spyod rgyud spyi rnam/ bya rgyud spyi rnam gnyis kyi bshad pa/ gzhan yang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa la sogs pa'i dbang rjes gnang bsam gyis mi khyab pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan no/ /rje btsun dam pa de dag gi thugs sras lam rim pa gnyis la 'gyur med kyi brtan pa mnga' bas/ tha mal snang zhen gyi 'khrul pa ring du gyur pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sems dpa' chen po blo gros rin chen pa spyan drangs te/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor lha bcu gsum ma/ mi bskyod pa so gnyis ma/ rnam snang sgyu drwa nas bshad pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' so bdun ma/ sgra nag bcu gsum ma ste/ pha rgyud bzhi/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis nas bshad pa'i thugs gsung sku snying po kyai rdo rje bzhi la lha mo brgyad brgyad kyis bskor ba bzhi/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga ma/ ku ru kul+le bco lnga la/ gur rigs sdud pa nga gsum ma/ gur nas bshad pa'i rdo rje sgrol ma lha bcu gcig ma/ saṃ bu ṭi nas bshad pa'i sku gsung thugs snying po kyai rdo rje lha bcu bdun ma bzhi/ rdo rje dbyings lha so bdun ma/ bdag med ma nyer gsum ma ste/ rgyud gsum nas bshad pa bcu bzhi/ 'khor lo bde mchog lo hi pa/ bde mchog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rtsa rgyud nas bshad pa'i drug cu rtsa gnyis ma/

phag mo dmar mo/ sngon mo/ ser mo lha so bdun ma gsum/ khro bo bcu'i dkyil 'khor/ 'khor los sgyur drug lha drug cu rtsa gsum ma/ rdo rje bdud rtsi lha so gcig ma/ nyer lnga ma/ nyer gcig ma/ bcu gsum ma ste bzhi/ rnal 'byor nam mkha' lha nga brgyad ma/ ye shes mkha' 'gro bcu gsum ma/ sangs rgyas thod pa nyer lnga ma/ sangs rgyas thod pa lha dgu ma/ sgyu ma chen mo lha lnga ma ste bde mchog gi bskor bcu bdun/ dus kyi 'khor lo lha stong dang bzhi yod pa/ de ltar na bla med kyi dkyil 'khor so drug yo ga rdo rje dbyings nga gsum ma/ chos dbyings gsung dbang lha brgya dang bcu gsum ma/ gtsug dgu lha so bdun ma ste gsum/ spyod rgyud nas bshad pa'i 'byung po 'dul byed so gsum ma/ 'od zer can nyer lnga ma/ bya rgyud nas bshad pa'i gzungs grwa lnga bcu gsum ma ste/ a bh+yas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor zhe gnyis/ slob dpon dar pan a tsar+yas gsungs pa'i gnod tshe thams cad sel bar byed pa gza' yum/ dbul ba thams cad sel ba nor rgyun ma/ tshe'i dngos grub ster ba/ rnam rgyal lha mang ste/ dkyil 'khor zhe lnga'i dbang 'phreng bskor ba gsum gyi lung man ngag dang bcas pa/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor/ 'od dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khar/ 'khor los sgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor/ me ltar 'bar ba phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug phyag na rdo rje la/ rgyal chen sde bzhis bskor ba/ lha chen brgyad kyis bskor ba/ klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba/ phyogs skyong bcus bskor ba/ gza' brgyad rgyud skar dang bcas pas bskor ba/ 'jigs byed chen po dgus bskor ba'i 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug ste sbyong rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po 'di yi dbang /

lag len bshad pa/ snur dang / rtsa skya pa'i yig cha'i lung dang bcas pa/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ gur rigs bsdus/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho la sogs pa/ mdor na rdo rje theg pa'i dbang rjes gnang / 'khrid lag len phra mo'i phra mo rnams kyang legs par gsan nas thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe dam pa de nyid sbas pa'i rnal 'byor du bzhugs pa dang / bdag nyid chen po 'di 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan du grags pas/ gzhan gyi blo la ma ran pa'i sgro bkur kyang yod mod/ kho bos ni 'di lta bu'i rnam par thar pa ches ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su mthong ste/ de yang dam pa'i chos las gus pa mchog tu gyur pa dang / khengs dregs dang nga rgyal gyi ri bo rmang nas 'gyel te/ dngos 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa rang sar zhig pa dang / rjes 'jug gi gdul bya rnams la nga rgyal dang / kheng dregs kyi gzhan dbang du ma song bar/ chos smra ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / dam pa'i chos la gces spras su gyis shig pa dang / mdor na/ chos brgyad kyi 'khri shing rtsa ba nas bcad de/ ma dag 'khrul snang rang sar zhig pa'i zab don gyi lta ba bzang po thugs su chud pa'i rtags so/ /mkhyen brtse mtshungs pa med pa bdag chen chu mig pa'i drung du yang / rje sa skya pa yab sras kyi bka' 'bum yongs su rdzogs pa dang / dpal ldan mgon po'i chos skor mtha' yas pa gsan no/ /mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bdag chen zha lu ba la/ dpal gdong bzhi pa'i chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa gsan zhing / chos rje gzhon nu seng ge ba la yang / dbang man ngag mang po dang / khyad par mgon po'i chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa gsan pa'i tshe/ bdag nyid chen po 'di yi mkhyen rab kyi rtsal la thugs lhag par dgyes spro chen pos bka' bsgo mdzad de/ dpal ldan mgon po/ bstan pa'i gsal byed byams chen rab 'byams pa'i bar chad srungs shig mthun rkyen sgrubs shig de ltar mi byed na khyed la bya rgyu ci 'dug gsung ba sogs gse 'bag nag po dbu la bzhag nas/

lha ngo mi ngo sprad/ dus de nyid nas sku dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs par grags pa yin no/ /gzhan yang chos kyi rje dge ba'i mtshan can la/ 'jigs byed la sogs pa'i gshed skor dang / thams cad mkhyen pa shes bya kun rig gi rgyal tshab/ shar dwags po'i paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas grub chen po bkra shis rnam rgyal la yang / mgon po'i chos skor mang du gsan zhing / ris med pa'i shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus par gzigs pa'i rgya chen chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i drung du/ dam tshig gsum bkod/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i rjes snang sogs mang du gsan zhing / mkhas grub chen po de'i thugs mkhyen brtse'i yon tan la/ thugs mthong lhag par che bas/ dad gus dang / bstod bkur bsngags gsum yang dang yang du mdzad do/ /gzhan yang tshul khrims kyi glang po mdo sngags yon tan gyi khur gyis lci ba/ chos rje rgyal ba phyag na'i drung du/ phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po rnam sras dmar ser gyi skor/ dur khrod bdag po'i chos skor/ theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi rigs mtha' dag dang bcas pa gsan no/ /mdor na sngar bshad pa'i dpal ldan bla ma de rnams la/ bstan pa'i bdag po dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bshad bsgrub/ dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan zhing / thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang rmad byung mkhyen rab kyi sdong po/ zab rgyas mdo sngags kyi me tog dang 'bras bu'i khur gyi lci ba mkhan chen pad+ma bzang po'i drung du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad sogs gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos skor yang mang du gsan no/ /snyan rgyud bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi nyams dang / rtogs pa'i lus stobs rab tu rgyas te/

grub pa'i sa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bzang tshe ri ba nam mkha' rgyal po'i drung du/ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa/ dbang lung man ngag zhal shes sogs ma lus pa dang / ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i chos skor yongs su rdzogs par gsan zhing / de'i tshe chos drug nyams 'khrid du mdzad cing / thugs nyams su bzhes pas rmi lam/ sbyong spel sprul bsgyur la sogs pa'i nyams ji ltar bshad pa bzhin skye ba 'byung ste/ bu slob kyi mgo 'don dgos pa dang / bstan pa'i bshad nyan gyi khur ches pas/ 'phro skyong chen po long ma byung gsung yang / bdag nyid chen po 'di shes rab dang / brtson 'grus kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ gzhan gyis bskal par bsgoms kyang skye dka' ba'i nyams rtogs khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs par gor ma chags so/ /gzhan yang 'phags pa'i yul gyi mkhas grub chen po/ paṇa chen nags rin pa'i drung du 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang / man ngag dang bcas pa gsan zhing thugs nyams su bzhes par mdzad de/ 'dir ni rags pa de tsam zhig brjod kyi/ rgyas par ni gsan yig las rtogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa de ltar mkhyen nas gzhan la bshad pa'i tshul ni/ bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud la sogs pa rgyud kyi skor 'ga' zhig dang / ma rgyud kyai rdo rje la sogs pa'i bskyed rdzogs yan lag dang bcas pa/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs yan lag dang bcas pa/ mkhas mang 'dus pa'i tshogs la mang du gsungs shing / mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i dgongs 'grel/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba/ legs par bshad pa las brtsams te/ rdo rje theg pa'i dbang / lung rjes gnang la sogs pa gdul bya rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams par rgya cher gsungs pa yin no/ /des na mkhas grub chen po 'dis/

phar phyin theg pa'i sde snod dang / rdo rje theg pa'i sde snod rnams skal ldan gyi gdul bya grangs med pa la/ tshig don 'khrul med du bshad pa'i sgo nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa mkhas pa lhur len pa phyi'i gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ nang zab don bdud rtsis 'tsho zhing / phyi brda sprod kyi gzhung lugs la mkhas pa/ lo chen thugs rje dpal pa'i drung du/ ka la pa/ tsan+d+ra pa/ tshig gi rgyan/ ming gi mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor la sogs pa'i tha snyad kyi gzhung rnams thugs la byang par mdzad nas/ sgra'i byings sgrub pa byed pa'i tshig sgrub pa sogs dpyis phyin pa thugs la chud par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe dpon slob rnams nyang stod du phyag phebs pa dang / dus mtshungs par paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal yang phyag phebs te/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis tha snyad kyi gzhung lugs de dag gi tshig don thugs la thogs pa med par gton nas/ 'bel gtam gyi skabs phye bas/ mkhas pa chen po de nyid kyang / bdag nyid chen po 'di yi rnam spyod kyi mthu la ngo mtshar du gyur te/ ā la la/ bod du 'gyur ba'i gzhung las sgra mdo sogs tha snyad kyi gzhung 'di dag las gyong pa med pa la/ 'di 'dra ya mtshan che gsung ba sogs bsngags pa ches cher mdzad do/ /des na gzhung lugs gang dang gang la gzhan gyis bskal par sbyangs kyang gting dpag par dka' ba de/ bdag nyid chen po 'di yi spyan zur rol tsam gyis tshig dang don gyi cha la 'khrul ba med par tshegs dang 'bad pa chung ngus shin tu mkhas par gyur to/ /'on kyang bdag nyid chen po 'di thugs nges don kho na la gzhol bas/ tha snyad kyi gzhung de dag gzhan la 'chad pa sogs kyi spros pa cher ma mdzad do/ /ji skad du/ zab rgyas nges don mdo rgyud bdud rtsi yi/ /bcud kyi dga' ston stsol bas brel gyur nas/ /tha snyad gtsug lag dran don zas sbyor gyi/

/ngal ba brten pa'i 'bad pas ci zhig bya/ /khyod kyi mkhyen rab lag pa'i 'khri shing gis/ /rgya chen mdo don gzugs mdzes la 'khyud pas/ /rgyud don 'chi med bu mo phrag dog ste/ /'di yi gam du myur 'gyogs 'ongs pa snyam/ /sde snod lang 'tsho gsar pas sgeg na yang / /zab mchog rdo rje theg pas ma brgyan na/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag por mi 'os zhes/ /mtha' yas rgyud sde'i dpal ni khyod kyis bslangs/ /rnam mang shes bya'i tshogs la mkhas na yang / /bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug pa'i zab lam gyis/ /tha mal snang zhen 'khrul pa ma bzlog na/ /tshe 'di nyid la myur du grol dka' bas/ /de phyir khyod kyi pha rol phyin pa yis/ /rin chen las grub yon tan lhun po de/ /bskyed rdzogs nyi zla zung gi dag snang dang / /nam yang 'bral med nyams len brtan par mdzad/ /gsum pa de dag gi don thugs nyams su bzhes tshul la/ nyin zhag phrug gcig la dam pa chos kyi nyams len ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul/ nang gi rtogs pa'i stobs kyis phyi rol du byin rlabs kyi rnam 'phrul byung tshul/ mnal lam sogs su dag pa'i snang ba ji ltar shar tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams bzang po snang la rang bzhin med par lta ba dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas spros bcas spros med kyi chos kyi mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / bdag cag rnams la mngon gyur ni/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig la/ nam gyi gung thun rnams legs par grub nas/ slar yang tho rangs kyang chag med mtha' yas pa de dag snga thun chug par mdzad de/ thor chos gsung ba la khri thog tu phebs/ tsha gong du chos thun bcu lhag re gnang / de nas zas kyi rnal 'byor gyis gsol ba mdzad pa sogs chos ldan gyi 'grigs rnams gnang / yang de ma thag khri thog tu phebs te/ snga chos thun bco lnga lhag tsam re gnang / yang gung thun rnams mdzad/ de nas gung tshigs grub 'phral chos khrir phebs/

dgong chos kyang chos thun bco lnga lhag pa re gnang / yang dgong thun rnams dang gsol ja sbrag pa zhig grub ma thag 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su phebs/ spyi'i chos spyod rnams dang / de sgrol nas tshogs pa spyi la 'dul ba'i bslab bya sogs ji ltar rigs pa'i tshogs chos cig gsungs/ de nas blo gsar ba rnams la sgos su blo mtho sman dang bstun pa'i chos thun gcig gnyis re gnang / slar yang srod thun rnams dang / gtor ma'i rim pa la tho rangs dkar cha bzhi dzam ser nag chu sbyin sogs mang po zhig dang / gung tshigs grol 'phral/ yon chab/ khrus gsol/ chu sbyin/ gzhi bdag brgya rtsa/ dbyug gu/ sgrol ma/ mi g.yo ba/ sbrul gtor/ cha gsum la sogs pa rnams dang / skabs su chos gtor/ thun gtor sogs dang / yi dam chos skyong la sogs pa'i nang gi gtor ma bcu tshar zhig bshams te gtor bsngos rgyas pa mdzad/ de yang yi dam lha'i sgom bzlas/ dbang bzhes pa sogs bskyed rdzogs kyi chag med bskor la/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chag med bzhi zhes yongs su grags pa 'di dag dang / bde mchog gshed dmar/ 'jigs byed/ mgon po'i skor/ tshe sgrub la sogs pa chag med rab tu mang po de dag thun bzhi dang / gsum mam/ gnyis las mi nyung bar mdzad cing / yi dam de dag gi rtsa sngags snying po/ nye snying la sogs pa'i bsnyen pa grangs med pa zhig dang / mthar nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis gzims te/ thog mar gcod kyi dmigs pa zab mo rnams kyang mdzad par nges te/ gzims g.yog pa la/ khyed rang yang gcod dmigs sgoms shig nged kyang bsgom gyin yod ces lan 'ga' gsung zer/ mnal dus su ne gu'i rmi lam sbyong spel/ sprul bsgyur sogs kyi nyams len zab mo rnams la rtsal 'don mdzad/ de nas zhu ba glus bskul ba sogs bzhengs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis bzhengs nas/ slar yang chos kyi rim pa de dag la 'jug cing / skabs su mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs rgya chen po rnams la gzigs rtog kyang rgyun ma chad par mdzad pa dang /

dgongs 'grel gyi brtsoms pa yang bsgrigs su bcug par mdzad pa'i thun dang / rim pa de dag las gzhan pa'i gsol ba dang gsol ja sogs kyi tshe yang / gsung rab kyi tshig dang don gyi cha nges par dka' ba rnams/ dri zhing rtsad pa'i skabs phye nas bde blag tu rtogs par mdzad pa sogs bdag nyid chen po 'di yi sgo gsum tha mal du gnas pa lta ci smros/ gzhan don du mi 'gyur ba'i skabs skad cig tsam yang ma mchis pa yin no/ /des na bdag nyid chen po 'dis yongs su rdzogs pa'i thub bstan rin po che 'degs pa'i khur chen 'di bzhes nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum rnams mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi rgyan dang skad cig kyang ma bral bar mthar phyin te/ don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzad pa'i tshul 'di ni/ tshul rol mthong ba rnams kyi blo'i spyod yul las ring du rgal ba yin no/ /ji skad du/ rin chen rgyan gos du mas klubs na yang / /bzar med phongs pa'i gdung ba bsten byed ltar/ /mtha' yas shes bya'i tshogs la mkhas na yang / /nyams len bcud dang bral na mi rung zhes/ /rab 'byams gzhung lugs rgyan gyis brjid pa khyod/ /nyams len bdud rtsi'i bcud la rtag rol cing / /byang phyogs mkhas grub cod pan khrir bzhugs nas/ /bstan pa'i rgyal srid skyong 'di nyid kyi tshul/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ nang gi thugs dam rtogs pa'i zil gyis phyi rol du byin rlabs kyi mthu bstan pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ bdag nyid chen po gang du bzhugs pa'i yul phyogs de dang der lo legs pa dang / nad dang 'thab rtsod dkon pa sogs 'jig rten gyi dge legs ma lus pa rang gi ngang gis 'byung zhing / khyad par mkhas grub chen po 'di nyid kyi bstan pa dar rgyas spel ba'i mthun rkyen/ zhabs tog la brtson pa'i sa skyong rgyal po sogs gang dang gang yin pa de rnams kyi/ phun tshogs dpal 'byor dang yar ngo'i zla ba 'gran pa bzhin du/

yongs su rdzogs par gang bar 'gyur ba sogs gangs can kun la gsal bar gyur ba dang / bdag nyid chen po'i srung mdud btags pa dang / phyag dbang zhus pa dang / phyag dang / bzhugs gding la sogs pa'i byin rlabs thob ma thag mi dang dud 'gro sogs nad dang gdon gyis gtses pa de dag de ma thag nad dang gdon las grol nas/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa sogs ni grangs las 'das shing / rin po che la lhag par dad pa'i chu 'dus pa'i grwa pa gcig la/ rde'u'i nad kyi gcong dam pos gzir te/ sman dpyad sogs thabs gang gis kyang ma phan par zug gzer bzod thabs med pas 'gum pa la nye ba na/ rje nyid phebs te byin rlabs mdzad pas/ sku mdun de nyid du rde'u mthe bo tsam zhig rtsol med du 'thon te/ sku mdun thams cad chus bkang / dus de nyid gcong las grol ba dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po me tog dpal ba/ tshad rims babs lci ba zhig gis gnyel te/ thabs du mas kyang phan bskyed med par/ zhal lkugs te zhag gsum bzhi tsam song nas/ kun gyis grongs pa thag bcad pa'i nub gcig rin po che nyid phebs te/ byin rlabs dang sems gso mdzad/ thugs rab tu brtse bas thugs dam skyabs 'og tu 'bral med bcug pas de nub khong la gnyid za ze zhig la/ mi nag po rab tu rngam zhing mi sdug pa zhig gis/ khong gi phyag dpe rnams khyer/ khyod nga'i zla la 'ong ngam mi 'ong zer ba sdigs pa na khong gis kyang de'i zla la byon pas/ rje rin po che chos gos ngur smrig rab tu mdzes pa zhig bzhes/ sku gzi mdangs dang ldan par phebs nas/ khong gis phyag nas bzung ste/ me tog dpal/ khyod la ci byung / khyod gang du 'gro gsung ste ma btang ba la/ na ba dang / lhags pa dang / gzhan gyi 'di bzhin khrid pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan rnams zhus pas/ 'o na lce rkyong dang / ngas lce mthong ma thag shes gsungs nas/ lce nas 'then pa snyam byed pa'i mod la gnyid sad de/

lce sngar ltar gyur/ nad las kyang grol 'dug pa dang / rab tu dga' zhing / yid ches pas/ bsnyung g.yogs pa rnams bos te/ lo rgyus bshad/ dus de nyid nas rin po che la/ bdud dpung bye ba'i rlung gis mi g.yo ba'i/ /dri med dad pa'i lhun po la dbang 'byor ba sogs/ tshul de lta bu byung tshul mtha' yas pa zhig yod do/ /de ltar na byin rlabs kyis snang ba zil gyis gnon pa'i tshul 'di yang 'gran zla ma mchis pa yin no/ /ji skad du/ zab yangs blo chen spyod pa'i chu gter che/ /blo chun bkod ma'i 'phar 'gro rang spyod kyi/ /'dom gyis tshad 'jal rab tu blun pa nyid/ /khron pa'i sbal pa lnga par mnal zhes thos/ /skal bzang dang ba'i mtsho la dam pa yi/ /byin rlabs rnam 'phrul gzugs brnyan ci yang 'char/ /rnyog bcas rdzing bur zla gzugs mi snang ba/ /de nyid zla ba'i skyon min rang skyon no/ /gsum pa mnal lam sogs su dag pa'i snang ba 'char tshul ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis mnal lam sogs su'ang / yi dam gyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang / mtha' yas pa'i gdul bya rnams la/ sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad du mnga' ba yin te/ de yang sku na 'phra mo'i dus su/ las 'gro dpal ldings su/ mkhas grub shākya bzang po la/ tshe dpag med lha dgu ma'i dbang gsan pa'i nub mo/ bcud kyis gang ba'i bum pa yid du 'ong ba zhig nas/ bdud rtsi yin snyam pa'i chu rgyun btung pa dang / gos chen dmar po las grub pa'i chos gos rab tu bzang ba gcig gyon pa'i rmi lam byung / phyis tshe yang legs po yin/ don du gnyer ba'i gtso bo bstan pa rin po che'i bshad nyan la/ bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa 'di la lta ba 'dra gsungs/ yang nged la gzhon dus/ mchod rten chen po/ de 'dra rnying pa mang po gsos pa dang / gsar pa bzhengs pa de dag la sku dkar gsol/ rgyan btags te mdzes par byas pa yang rmis/

phyis bstan pa rin po che'i bshad nyan legs po 'byung ba 'di la lta ba 'dra gsungs/ yang nged kyis ri rab tu mtho ba zhig gi rtse'i phyogs bzhir/ dar po che re re legs par 'phyar ba rmis/ phyis de'i dus kyi ri mthon po de 'bras yul gyi ri mtho ba 'di'i rnam pa kho nar 'dug lung pa 'dir nged rang gi gdul bya phyogs kun nas 'du ba 'di la lta ba 'dra gsungs pa dang / yang nged chu shul na yod dus grwa tshang de la mthu yod zer ba bden pa 'dra/ nub re bzhin khang stong sgo med rab tu 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' la nyam nga ba'i nang du tshud nas/ gang du ltas kyang thar pa'i go skabs ma rnyed pas rkyen byas te/ 'di dag bden med yin snyam du/ snang ba bden med du bsgrubs pa'i gtan tshigs bzang po re bkod nas/ de ma thag snang ba 'di bde phyam gyis song nas/ skrag pa dang 'jigs pa de rang grol du gyur pa yang byung / nged la de dus ye ma tshugs gsung / yang nged la skabs su gzhon nu'i dus su srog chags kyi tshogs nyam thag pa mang po mthong nas/ de dag la brtse bas mi bzod pas/ gos dang phying ba g.yogs pa dang / zas skom byin pa sogs sdug bsngal de dang de las grol bar bya'o snyam pa'i rmi lam yang yang 'ong ba gcig yod de/ phyis sems can mang po la phan thogs byung ba 'di la lta ba 'dra gsung ba dang / yang nged la lan gcig gangs ri 'jigs pa'i sul thams cad kyang 'khyags sbugs ser kha shig ge ba/ bar snang la bu yug rlung gis bskyod pa'i kha rlung cher 'bab pa/ rab tu nyam nga bas skrag pa dang / 'jigs pa'i go skabs ci yang 'byed pa/ grang ba'i dmyal ba yin zer ba gcig gis gangs ri'i khong gseng nas/ nged rang la snying brtse ba gcig yin snyam byed pa'i smre sngags nyam thag pa'i cho nges lhang lhang ba gcig tshor ba dang / snying rje bzod thabs med pas/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la/ gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab ste/

rje btsun ma/ sems can grang ba'i dmyal ba 'di las bskyab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pa'i mod la/ tsha zer dpag med 'phro ba'i nyi ma rab tu dro ba zhig shar te/ gangs dang 'khyag sbubs de thams cad rang dbang med par zhu/ sa phyogs de thams cad kyang bsod nams ldan pa'i bza' shing gi ra ba/ dbyar gyi dus la bab pa ltar ljon shing me tog mngon par bkra ba sna tshogs kyis yongs su khebs pas/ nyams dga' zhing yid du 'ong ba'i tshal/ phun sum tshogs par gyur pa'i mod la/ sems can de yang 'don pa snyam byed pa gcig rmis gsung ba dang / yang nged la lan gcig gcong rong rab tu mi zad pa zhig na/ chu bo chen po kha dog dmar ser du 'dug pa/ mtha' mi mngon pa'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho yin zer ba gcig gi 'gram na/ nged dpon slob kyang mang po 'dug gzhan yang ngo shes pa dang mi shes pa mang po 'dug chu bo de la nged kyis zam pa gtsug nas sgrol ba'i lugs su byed pa dang / nyam nga ba'i gcong rong de nas/ nged kyis ri mthon po zhig gi rtse la phyin/ de'i rjes la mang po byung na snyam pa la ma byung / rje sa skya pa'i rnam thar na bzhugs pa de cha 'dra ba gcig nged la rmis/ rgod bro gsung ba sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsung bar 'dug kyang / 'dir dran pa'i me long la gsal ba 'di tsam bkod pas mtshon pa tsam mo/ /ji skad du/ dmigs med thugs rje ring du goms pa'i mthus/ /rmi lam na yang mtha' yas gdul bya'i tshogs/ /sdug bsngal gsum las bsgrol bar mdzad pa yi/ /dmigs med thugs rje'i tshul 'di rgyun mi 'chad// //bzhi pa thub pa'i rgyal sa gzung ba'i slad du 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa spel ba'i tshul la/ thabs gang la brten nas bstan pa spel tshul dang / gzhan spro ba bskyed pa'i ched du bstan pa'i che ba bstan tshul lo/ /dang po la/ 'chad pa yid bzhin nor bus chos kyi 'phongs pa'i dbul ba gsal nas bstan pa spel tshul/

rtsod pa seng ge'i nga ros phas rgol zil gyis mnan nas bstan pa spel tshul/ rtsom pa sdebs legs rin chen phreng bas blo gros lus bzang brgyan nas bstan pa spel tshul lo/ /dang po la/ gang la brten nas 'chad pa rgyu'i khyad par/ yul gang la 'chad pa gdul bya'i khyad par/ ji srid du bshad pa dus kyi khyad par/ gang zhig bshad par bya ba chos kyi khyad par/ gang gis 'chad pa thabs mkhas kyi khyad par/ de ltar bshad pas mkhas pa skrun pa phrin las kyi khyad par ro/ /dang po la/ bsam pa brtse ba'i khyad par/ mkhas pa shes rab kyi khyad par/ sbyor ba bzod ldan gyi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di dam pa'i chos 'chad pa sogs sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag brnyed bkur sogs la chags pa med pa'i snying rje chen po 'ba' zhig gis nye bar bskul nas mdzad pa yin te/ ji skad du/ slob dpon brtse chen rtag tu bsten pa'i bdag /pha rol sdug bsngal dag gis sems gdungs pa/ /gzhan gyi bya ba nye bar gnas pa la/ /gzhan gyis bskul ba shin tu ngo yang tsha/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ pha rol po nad kyis gzir ba dang / zas gos kyis 'phongs pa dang / phan tshun mi mthun pa'i rtsod pa byed pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur nas sdig pa kham po che la 'jug pa sogs gzigs pa dang / gsan pa'i mod la snying re rje snying re rje gsung ba sogs bzod thabs med pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam 'gyur ci yang g.yo ba dang / sdug bsngal de dang de las grol ba'i 'bad pa lhur bzhes pa dang / nad pa la sman dang nad g.yog 'phongs pa la zas gos rtsol ba/ mi mthun pa bsdum pa/ sdig pa kham po che la 'jug pa la/ dngos dang brgyud pas nyes spyod la bzlog pa'i thabs la nan tan gyis 'bad pa mdzad cing / nad pa sogs 'phongs pa rnams gsol ras kyis gso ba dang / gsol ba mdzad pa na drung du lhags pa'i sems can brkam chags can bya rog dang /

bya byi la sogs pa la gsol ba bgo bsha' mdzad pa dang / gsung chos gnang ba sogs la 'byon dus/ gsol ras rnams la zhal chab dang / byin rlabs mdzad de sbyin yul 'phongs pa de dag sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las grol bar mdzad pa'i brtse bas 'phral dang yun du phan bde la sbyor ba dang / glo bur du phyogs gzhan la thegs dgos shar na/ bka' drin rtsol ba'i sems can de dag la lhag par brtse bas 'di dag gi lto skal 'chad do gsung nas/ ngan long mdze sprang / khyi/ bya byi sogs la ji ltar rigs pa'i phogs btab/ gnyer pa bskos nas mgon med pa'i sems can de dag bkres skom dang 'bral ba'i bde ba la 'god par mdzad do/ /khyad par sku dngos kyi gdul bya grwa pa'i tshogs la/ nged kyi lus longs spyod/ dge ba rgyu 'bras/ bde skyid thams cad bstan pa dang grwa pa sogs sems can kyi ched du bsngos pa yin pas/ nged kyi bla brang la gcod pa'i sgo med/ bsrung ba'i khyi med/ thams cad kyang gang 'dug zo/ 'thung / nye bar mkho ba gang 'dug la longs spyad pas chog gsung zhing / zhabs rdul na gnas pa rnams la yang de kho na ltar 'doms pa dang / sbyin bdag dang 'byor can rnams kyi phul ba'i na bza' dpag med byung ba rnams kyang / chos kyi dka' spyad dang du bzhes pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gos kyis 'phongs pa rnams la khyab par mdzad pa dang / phyag rdzas nas bor stor phran tshegs byung ba'i skad cha gsan na snying re rje/ nged kyis bdag tu bzung ba cher med pas sdig pa chen po mi 'ong / de dag la ci nas kyang phan thogs par gyur cig gsung ba sogs brtse ba'i khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /gzhan yang / sbyin pa po ni longs spyod mi 'dod kyang / /longs spyod shin tu bzang la mang dang phrad/ /bdag ni bde ba de 'dod ma yin te/ /ji ltar bdag ni sbyin par brgyud dang ldan/ /zhes pa ltar/ phyag tu legs par babs pa'i longs spyod kyi dngos po rnams/

dkon mchog mchod pa dang / 'gyed mang ja sogs dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog longs spyod kyis 'phongs pa'i gdul bya so so la/ gang la gang 'tsham gyi sbyin pa rtsol ba sogs/ dmigs su gang 'gro 'phral 'phral du mdzad/ de dag dgongs pa bzhin grub pa'i tshe/ rlabs po che'i dge ba rnams/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi ched kho nar bsngo ba mdzad/ sbyin yul de dag gis longs spyod kyi dngos po rgya chen po thob pa'i tshe/ bdag nyid chen po 'di thugs dgyes pa'i zag med kyi dga' bas/ sbyin yul rnams kyi 'dod pa rdzogs pa'i dga' ba zil gyis gnon pa ni/ sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' kho na'i spyod yul te/ rje btsun gyis/ ji ltar blo ldan 'di na bdog pa kun gtong bas/ /don gnyer skye bo dga' bas dga' ba ltar/ /de ltar slong mo ba dag slang bya ba/ /'dod dgu thob pa dag gis dgar mi gyur/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na brtse ba snying rje chen pos kun nas blangs nas/ zang zing gi sbyin pa phyogs med du gtong ba 'di rnyed pa dang bkur sti la cung zad kyang chags pa med par/ zab rgyas kyi chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i chos kyi rgyu'i gtso bor shes par bya'o/ /ji skad du/ gang gis snying rje'i sprin tshogs g.yo ba las/ /rab snyan gsung gi 'brug sgra sgrog pa dang / /'dod dgu'i char rgyun dpag yas stsol ba yis/ /gdul bya'i re ba bltas pa'i dga' ston sgrub/ /de tshe gzhan dag dga' bas dga' ba yi/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi ro mchog 'di/ /bdag nyid chen pos legs par gsol gyur pas/ /'dod yon sred pa zad la ngo mtshar ci/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis bdag bde gzhan sbyin nas/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag gir mdzad pa rdzun/ /gal te bden na zag med bde ba kun/ /khyod nyid gcig pos gsol ba ji ltar lags/ /dmigs med snying rje'i nyi gzhon 'di shar nas/ /rtsub sems zhe sdang ku mud zum pa dang /

/lung rtogs phan bde'i pad tshal rgyas pa gnyis/ /phan tshun kun nas 'dren pa bzhin du gyur/ /dmigs med snying rje'i 'od zer 'bum ldan pa'i/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i 'od stong 'di mthong nas/ /nam mkha'i nor bu rab tu skyengs pa yis/ /nub ri'i phag tu yang yang 'bros pa snyam/ /gnyis pa/ mkhas pa'i shes rab ni/ bshad bya'i don la mkhas pa/ 'chad byed kyi tshig la mkhas pa/ ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul la mkhas pa sogs/ gang nas bshad kyang 'brel chags pa/ gang la bshad kyang don go ba/ ji tsam bshad kyang ran pa sogs gzhan las khyad zhugs pa'i spobs pa mnga' bas/ gsung rab mtha' dag la/ ma rtogs/ log rtog the tshom gyi dri ma bsal te/ gdul bya so so la tshig don 'khrul med du rtogs pa'i blo gros kyi snang ba bskyed par mdzad pa ni/ mkhas pa'i shes rab kyi khyad par ro/ /gsum pa/ sbyor ba bzod ldan ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ thub pa'i dbang po'i rgyal sa bzung nas/ bshad sgrub gnyis kyi bka' khrims chen po bcas te/ lung dang rtogs pa'i rgyal khams rab tu yangs pa dge bar bskyangs pa la/ chu srin rgyal mtshan can gyi srid du gtogs pa'i nag po'i sde mtha' dag gi dngos dang / brgyud pas tho 'tshams pa'i bar chad rgyun ring du brtsams kyang / phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i bdag nyid chen po 'di yi/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ cung zad kyang sgrib par mi nus pa 'di ni bzod pa bla na med pa mnga' ba'i mthu yin te/ gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pas brtan pa'i khur chen 'degs pa'i tshe/ dka' spyad kyi ngal dub tu mi 'gyur/ sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pas/ gzhan don rgya chen po la 'jug pa'i tshe/ gzhan gyi log sgrub kyi skyo bar mi 'gyur/ chos la nges rtog gi bzod pas/ gsung rab kyi tshig don la 'jug pa'i tshe/ spros bcas kyi mtshan mas 'ching bar mi nus shing /

spros bral rtogs pa'i lta ba gong du 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / bdag nyid chen po 'di la/ thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni/ /zang zing med par chos sbyin dang / /sangs rgyas zhing kun sbyong ba dang / /'khor bas yongs su mi skyo dang / /ngo tsha khrel med ces bya ba/ /rlom med bdag nyid de rnams lnga/ /zhes pa ltar/ sa gsum pa'i yon tan rnams gsal bar mnga' ba yin te/ dam pa'i chos rgya chen po thos pas ngoms pa med pa'i yon tan dang / zab rgyas chos kyi sbyin pa rlabs po che rnams kyang / zang zing gi rnyed pa dang / bkur sti'i ched ma yin par sbyin pa dang / bdag nyid chen po 'di la/ gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas/ sku lus 'tsho ba'i zas gos sogs 'phral gyi 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnams la/ blang dor bzang ngan/ skyid chos kyi dbang du skad cig kyang ma song bar sku tshe ril po bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi khur bsnams pa 'di yang / yul la bzang ngan gyi blang dor med par dag pa kho nar snang ba'i zhing sbyong ba'i yon tan mnga' ba yin te/ rje btsun gyis/ sems can 'jig rten de bzhin du/ /snod kyi 'jig rten ma dag pa/ /de la dag par sgrub pa yi/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni dag pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'khor bas yongs su mi skyo ba'i don yang / 'grel par/ phan btags pa'i sems can mi mthun pa la sogs pa mthong bas yongs su mi skyo ba dang / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag nyid chen po 'di la yang / lugs gnyis kyi bka' drin 'khor thabs med pas bskyangs pa rnams kyis/ chos dang 'gal ba'i log sgrub mi 'tshams pa sna tshogs byas pa na/ thog mar dngos dang brgyud pa'i gzham sgo'i thabs du ma nas de las bzlog pa'i thabs la nan tan mdzad cing / des kyang bzlog par nus shing / bstan pa rin po che la 'phral phugs su gnod par 'gyur ba'i dgag bya chen po dang / gdul bya de nyid kyang zhi ba'i thabs kyis chos kyi srol du ma tshud cing /

sdug bsngal gyi rgyu/ sdig pa'i rgyun rje 'phel du 'gyur bar gzigs nas/ gnas skabs su bka' bkyon pa dang / gnas nas skrod pa sogs mdzad kyang / de nyid la lhag par brtse ba'i tshul/ gzhan las kyang ches che ba mnga' ba yin te/ rje btsun gyis/ rtag tu nyes pas rang med bya sems kyis/ /skye bo la ni blo ldan nyes par mi 'dzin te/ /mi 'dod bzhin du log par sgrub pa 'gyur ro zhes/ /skye bo dag la snying rje rnam par 'phel phyir ro/ /zhes dang / zhi ba lhas/ nyon mongs skyes pas de lta bur/ /bdag gsod la sogs zhugs pa la/ /snying rje brgya la ma skyes na/ /khro bar gyur pa ci tha tshig /ces pa ltar ro/ /des na/ khong khro ba med kyang / phyi rol du khro ba'i rnam par ston pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzhan don byed pa thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par yin te/ zhi ba lhas/ mi srun 'gro la byang sems bskyed/ /tsub spyod kho nas 'dul bar gsungs/ zhes dang / bu dang slob ma mi 'chos dang / /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo mi sgom zhing / /khro bo'i bzlas pa 'gog pa sogs/ /snying rje'i dbang gis byed na yang / /ma dag pa yi snying rje yin/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /'dir theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dang / rgyud sde zab mo rnams kyi thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par/ 'phrul gyi sgo mtha' yas pa zhig phyes te/ bshad du yod kyang ma spros so/ /bdag gzhan rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ mi dge ba'i chos la mi 'jug cing / dge ba'i chos gong 'phel du mdzad pas na/ ngo tsha shes pa dang / khrel yod pa'i yon tan mnga' ba yin no/ /de ltar yongs sbyong gi chos lnga po de dag kyang / chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i lta ba/ dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rlom pa med pas rgyas btab ste/ dus nam yang 'bral ba med par gnas pa 'di/ mkhas par sbyangs pa dang / btsun par bsrung ba'i mthar thug gi dgos pa'i mchog bzang ba'i tshul la 'gran zla med par bzhugs pa yin no/

/ji skad du/ rgyal sras rlabs chen spyod la zhugs rnams la/ /ji tsam gnod pa de tsam spyod pa'i grogs/ /lhun stug nags tshal zhugs kyis bsreg pa'i tshe/ /stobs chen rlung la gegs zhes bya mi rung / /gang gis thub bstan dge bar skyong ba yi/ /rab brtan lhun po g.yo bar sems byed pa'i/ /nag phyogs gzhan 'phrul dbang byed srid bcas ni/ /re ba'i 'bras med ngal bar ma gyur tam/ /gnyis pa gang la brten nas gdul bya'i khyad par ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i chos kyi mdun sar lhags pa'i gdul bya yongs ni/ dad pa dang yid ches kyi dad pa che ba/ skye stobs dang sbyangs stobs kyi shes rab che ba/ gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus che ba/ snying rus dang dka' spyad kyi bzod sran che ba/ mthun rkyen dang longs spyod kyi dpal 'byor che ba/ pho rus dang gus zhen gyi zhabs tog che ba/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti'i gtong phod che ba sogs/ mdor na mkhas grub kyi rgyu tshogs grangs tshang zhing / 'gal rkyen gegs med pa sha stag 'dus shing / khyad par sa skyong rgyal po'i sras la sogs pa/ rigs rus dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba rnams kyang / bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi chos kyi mdun sar rang gi ngang gis 'du ba sogs/ rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la/ theg pa chen po'i 'phags pa sha stag gi 'khor dang ldan pa bzhin no/ /rnam dkar phrin las dri bsung cher 'phro zhing / /dmigs med snying rje'i pad dkar mdangs gsal ba'i/ /lung rtogs yon tan pad mtsho rgyas pa yis/ /dad ldan skal bzang dang ba'i tshogs 'di bsdus/ /zab don pad+ma'i rtsa bas 'tsho byed cing / /legs bshad gsung snyan sgrogs pa'i 'gyur khugs dang / /lung rtogs nor bu'i mtsho la rtse ba yis/ /thub bstan 'dzin ma'i khyon 'di mdzes par byas/ /gsum pa ji srid du bshad pa dus kyi khyad par la/ bshad nyan mdzad tshul gyi dus kyi khyad par spyir bstan pa dang /

dkon mchog gi lung bstan nas bshad nyan khyad par can ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa la bka' bcu'i grwa skor mdzad pa'i dus de nas/ mthar dgung lo don lnga'i bar du rgyun ma chad par zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i mdzad pa kho nas dus 'da' ba yin la/ de yang gsang phu la sogs par gdul bya nyung shas la grogs ldan mdzad/ mkhas pa'i grags pa yang ches cher 'phel/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa la rong du phebs/ sngar gsan sbyong mdzad pa'i po ti che ba mang po zhig gi gzhung la gzigs rtog gi dgongs pas dkar po chos lung du dpe mtshams la phebs/ de dus sang zhogs 'dzin rgyu'i gzhung de/ de dus tshar gnyis gsum re klog par mdzad/ sang mthong 'phral nas bzung bas/ tsha gong du shog bu bco lnga tsam re bzung / grags pa gzhung shog bco brgyad ma re bzung bar grags gsung / de nas rje mkhyen rab dbang phyug gi grwa tshang du phebs/ mkhas pa de'i 'chad pa'i khur ma lus pa mkhas grub 'di nyid kyis bzhes te/ lo ngo bcu gsum gyi bar du 'dod dgu'i legs par bshad pa'i char gyis/ blo gsal 'dus pa'i tshogs de dag chos kyi 'byor pa dang ldan pa'i mkhas btsun gyi go 'phang bla na med pa la bkod par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe grwa sa de na/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i gsung gi bdud rtsis mi 'tsho ba ni/ gsum bzhi las med do zhes zur gnas dag gsung ngo / /de nas thams cad mkhyen pa shes bya kun rig gi chos grwa chen po dpal na len+d+rar phebs te/ der 'dus pa'i tshogs rab tu che ba zhig gi yongs su 'dzin par phebs nas/ legs par bshad pa'i chos sbyin lo bdun gyi bar du mdzad do/ /gnyis pa la/ dkon mchog gi bshad nyan gyi sgo nas bstan pa la phan par lung bstan tshul dang / lung bstan nas bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ de nas bdag nyid chen po 'di nges 'byung dang skyo shas ni dri gzhon pa ltar du g.yo/

brtse ba'i gdung shugs drag po ni ri gzar gyi chu klung ltar 'bab/ bstan pa'i gces spras dang khur ni rang 'tsho ba'i srog ltar du gces/ bsam sbyor gyi dam bca' dang snying stobs ni ri rgyal lhun po ltar du brtan/ rgya chen mkhyen rab kyi khyon ni nam mkha' ltar yangs/ gzhan phan lhag bsam gyi go cha ni gangs ri ltar du brjid pas/ 'di snyam du dgongs so/ /kho bos yang na ni ri'i bu byas/ na bun gyi gos gyon/ 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba thams cad rgyang ring du dor nas/ tshe 'di nyid la mchog gi go 'phang brnyes pa mi la ras pa lta bu gcig bya/ yang na ni bod yul mkhas pa'i dbang po/ lo chen blo ldan shes rab ltar thub bstan yid bzhin nor bu bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor bkod de/ lung rtogs 'dod dgu'i char gyis sdug bsngal me 'obs na gnas pa'i sems can 'di dag thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bsil ba'i dngos po thob par bgyis la/ rnam par grol ba mchog la 'god par bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/ dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pa'i lung bstan zhu ba dang / bdag nyid chen pos thugs dam la mnyam par bzhag ste/ bstan pa la gang phan gyi brtag pa mdzad pas/ dus gsum thogs med du gzigs pa de dag gis kyang / bdag nyid chen po 'di bshad nyan gyi sgo nas yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan pa'i bdag po 'ba' zhig tu lung bstan zhing / khyad par de'i dus mnal lam du/ la stod rgyal gyi shrī ri yin zer ba'i ri rab tu mtho zhing nyams dga' la yid du 'ong ba zhig gi ngos la/ brag phug shin tu yangs pa rang bzhin gyis dang ba 'dren cing / bag phebs pa zhig gi logs thams cad la/ lung gi po ti brag ri bsgrigs pa ltar pha mtha' mi mngon pa/ rgya che ba gcig 'dug pa'i bdag por bsko gzhag byas/ gnyer gtad pa gcig rmis pas/ dgongs pa la po ti 'di shin tu mang bas bshad nyan bstan pa la phan pa'i brda chos su go gsung zhing /

de dus ngo mtshar gyi gtam du bya ba'i mnal lam gyi ltas khyad par can mang po zhig byung 'dug kyang / sku drung du rgyas par zhu ma nus shing / dran pa'i dbang po la gsal mi gsal ci rigs pa las mi 'dug pas 'dir bkod ma nus so/ /des na/ dus gsum la chags thogs mi mnga' ba'i rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang / bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ bshad nyan gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bya ba byed dgos par lung bstan par mdzad do/ /gnyis pa rgyal bas lung bstan na bstan pa rgyas par mdzad tshul ni/ de ltar lung bstan pa'i tshe/ bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i lhag bsam dang snying stobs can 'dis/ chags sdang med pa'i chos mthun gyi bshad nyan 'gran zla ma mchis pa/ nam langs pa'i khar nyi ma shar ba lta bu zhig gis/ thub pa'i ring lugs chen po 'di rmangs nas bslangs te/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi gdung gsos pas dgyes pa chen po bskyed par bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/ mkha' reg bod 'brug tu bstan pa'i gzhi gting ba'i tshe/ dus gsum la chags thogs mi mnga' ba'i ye shes brnyes pa/ mkhas grub chen po rong ston shes bya kun rig gi legs par gsan nas/ thugs lhag par dgyes spro chen po dang bcas te/ ā la la/ e ma ho/ rab 'byams pa khos/ lo 'brug lo la/ gnas bod 'brug tu/ bshad nyan 'brug ldir ba lta bu gtsug nas/ 'brug gsum 'dzoms 'dug pas/ bod yul 'di kho'i snyan grags kyis legs par 'gengs shing / bshad nyan yang legs po 'ong zhes gsungs nas lung bstan zhing / lung bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin thams cad la mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /de nas bstan pa rin po che la mi phyed pa'i dad gus can/ rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs shing / bsod nams chen po'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba/ sa skyong mi'i dbang po khri dpon kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas/ rang gi chos sde dpal mngon dgar spyan drangs te/ zla ba gsum bzhi tsam gyi zhabs tog mdzad nas bzhugs/

slar yang mkha' reg dang / bu sde skor du phyag phebs chos thog gsum bzhi tsam bzhugs/ de'i bar la dag pa'i 'khor tshogs nyis brgya tsam 'dus par gyur to/ /de nas sku tshe dpag tu med pa nas legs byas dang smon lam rlabs po ches mtshams sbyar ba'i/ bstan pa rin po che'i sbyin bdag sngon thub pa'i dbang po nyid chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gzhi rten mdzad pa'i sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po de dag dang kun nas tshul mtshungs shing / gang gi yan lag bcu gnyis pa'i dpung gi stobs bskyod pas/ sum cu rtsa sum gyi bdag po yang khengs pa dang bral nas gus pas 'dud par byed cing / sa'i gzhi la 'khod pa'i rgyal phran rnams kyis kyang / bka'i gcod pan spyi bor 'ching ba'i bka' drin zhus te/ yan lag mchog gis gus pas 'dud pa'i slad du/ khrims chen po'i thabs bla na med pa la mnga' mdzad nas/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams chen po 'di bde skyid kyis skyong ba'i tshul la 'gran zla ma mchis pa/ sa'i brgya sbyin chen po gzhis kha rin sprungs pa zhes rab snyan grags pa'i 'od dkar gyis phyogs thams cad la khyab pa/ dpal mi'i dbang po drung chen nor bu bzang po dang / gang gi dri ma med pa'i dad gus kyi gser ri mngon par 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ thub bstan lhun po'i dpal du yongs su bskor ba'i mdzes pa bskyed cing / dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i rol mtsho skyil bas bstan 'dzin klu dbang kun gyis nye bar mchod pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ sems can thams cad la rgyu med par gnyen bzhin pa'i brtse ba chen pos/ sngon gyi rgyal po byams pa'i stobs dang / thams cad sgrol la sogs pa dang dbyer ma mchis pa/ sa skyong mi'i dbang po chos kyi rgyal po dpal bzang rin chen pa dang / rgyal ba'i bstan pa dad pas mchod cing / yangs pa'i rgyal khams byams pas skyong ba'i slad du/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma gnam sa'i bdag mor sku sprul ba/

lha lcam ye shes mtsho rgyal yab yum bka' bgros te/ bka' yig rim par phebs pa'i mthu las/ ji skad du/ blo ldan gang du bsgrub pa'i yul/ /legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang / /sa bzang pa dang grogs bzang dang / /rnal 'byor bde ba'i yon tan ldan/ /zhes pa'i khyad chos lnga dang ldan zhing / rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba dang tshul mtshungs pa/ 'bras yul rdzong dkar gyi skyed mod tshal zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid du/ bdag nyid chen po dgung lo so dgu bzhes pa/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs dang bcas sa mo sbrul gyi zla ba dang po la phyag phebs te/ dgung lo don lnga'i bar du zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par bskor bar mdzad do/ /des na/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa nas/ don lnga'i bar lo ngo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad du bshad sgrub kyi zla ba'i dkar cha gong 'phel gyur pas/ thub bstan gyi cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i lung rigs kyi dpal gyis gang ba'i dkyil 'khor/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs pa ste/ bzhengs pa'i dgongs pa mthar phyin par mdzad pa yin no/ /ji skad du/ dam pa gang gi thugs la 'di ltar dgongs/ /rang gi 'od kyi snang bas rang lus tsam/ /gsal ba 'di ni me khyer srin bu yi/ /ngang tshul yin gyi bdag gi cha ma yin/ /'od stong rab tu rgyas pa'i mkhas mchog 'dis/ /thub bstan pad tshal bzhad pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /blo gsal bung ba tshim par ma byas na/ /bshes gnyen rgyu skar gzhan dang khyad ci yod/ /zla ba mkha' la rgyu bas mdzes pa bzhin/ /'di yis snying stobs bstan pa'i mkha' la rgyu/ /chags sdang chu 'dzin las grol mtshan mo'i mgon/ /skal bzang sgyu skar dbus na mdzes par gyur/ /de nas de yi grags pa'i 'od dkar gyis/ /sa skyong snying gi ku mud phye ba las/ /dad pa'i 'dzum mdangs ci yang gsal ba yis/

/gsung gi dri bsung spro ba'i go skabs phye/ /de tshe dam pa 'di yi dgongs pa la/ /thub bstan pad tshal zum nas gnas pa de/ /kho bo'i legs bshad lung rigs tsha zer dang / /mi dbang gang gis dpal 'byor rlan drod gnyis/ /zung du 'jug pa'i thabs mkhas phun tshogs las/ /byang phyogs gangs ri'i rgyud 'di ma lus pa/ /mkhas grub me tog 'bras bus khyab pa yis/ /thub bstan pad tshal rab tu rgyas byed dgongs/ /e ma mkhas pa nyin mo'i dbang phyug dang / /sa skyong rgyu skar bdag po gnyis bgros nas/ /'jig rten gsal ba'i 'od dkar 'di 'dra na/ /mkha' la sgyu ba'i nyi zla ci zhig bya/ /bzhi pa gang bshad par bya ba chos kyi khyad par ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsung bka' bsdu ba po rnams kyis bsdus/ grub thob rnams kyis thugs nyams su bzhes pas grol/ paṇa chen mkhas pa rnams kyis nyan bshad kyi sgo nas gtan la phab/ 'khrul pa zad pa'i lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis legs par bsgyur ba'i mdo sde dang / rgyud sde dag gi dgongs 'grel rgyan drug dang / mchog gnyis la sogs pa gzhung lugs chen po 'gyur ro cog ni dam pa 'di nyid kyi bshad par bya ba'i chos yin zhing / gdul bya so so'i blo dang 'tshams par/ gang la gang 'dod kyi sgo nas 'chad par mdzad do/ /lnga pa ji ltar 'chad pa thabs mkhas kyi khyad par ni/ bshad bya'i gzhung lugs de dag gi tshig don ma lus pa kun chud par mdzad nas/ nyin nub kyi dbye ba med par thugs kho na las gsung ba'i tshul 'di ni/ 'phags pa gzungs thob pa 'ba' zhig gi spyod yul du snang la/ de yang rgyud sde 'chad pa na/ mtha' drug tshul bzhi/ rgyan drug la sogs pas skabs phye ste 'chad/ mdo sde 'chad pa na/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas gleng bslangs te 'chad/ bstan bcos 'chad pa na/ 'chad thabs kyi man ngag lnga la sogs pa'i thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas 'chad do/ /'chad tshul de dag kyang khyad par gyi chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'chad do/

/ji skad du/ rgya chen the tshom spong ba dang / /gzung 'os de nyid gnyis ston pa/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /ston pa phun tshogs yin zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi nang gi grub mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son pas rgya che ba/ tshig don mtha' dag phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i shes rab mnga' bas/ gdul bya'i the tshom spong ba/ ji skad bstan pa bzhin du/ thugs nyams su bzhes pas gzung bar 'os pa/ blang dor gyi gnas kun nas nyon mongs kyi de kho na nyid dang / rnam byang gi de kho na nyid phyin ci ma log par ston par mdzad pa'o/ /mdor na sngon thub pa'i dbang po de nyid seng ge'i khri la mngon par phyogs te/ zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ji lta bar/ gdul bya la mgo smras pas go ba dang / /rnam par spros pas go dgos pa rnams la/ de dang de'i skal ba dang 'tshams par dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'chad pas/ mkhas pa gzhan dag la tshar grangs med nyan pa las/ bdag nyid chen po 'di la/ tshar re re gnyis gnyis nyan pa gnas skabs su bogs dang blo bskyed che la/ mthar snyan grags dang gzhan phan phrin las che ba 'di ni/ nang gi mkhyen brtse'i lhag bsam gzhan las ches mchog tu gyur pa zhig gi mthu yin par rig par bya'o/ /de yang rgyal ba'i yum dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa gsung ba'i tshe/ 'dod pa dang gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams grangs med pa dag nas/ lha rdzas kyi me tog gi skyes 'bul ba ni yum gyi gleng gzhi nas ji skad 'byung ba dang tshul mtshungs pas/ me tog gi char gangs ri'i stod g.yogs nyil ba ltar sa gzhi chag chag 'debs pa dang / mdzes par byed pa sogs dad pa'i rgya mtsho mngon par 'phel ba ni/ grong pa'i skye bo byin la thun mong du gyur pas 'jig rten kun las ches cher grags pa yin no/ /drug pa de ltar bshad pas mkhas pa bskrun pa phrin las kyi khyad par ni/

kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di na/ bdag nyid chen po 'di yi gsung gi bdud rtsi las 'khrungs pa'i thugs sras/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che mtha' dag la dbang 'byor ba/ gzhung lugs rab 'byams kyi do shal bzang pos mdzes par byas pa/ rab 'byams pa/ bka' bcu pa/ bka' bzhi pa la sogs pa'i mtshan gsol ba dang ma gsol ba/ lung rigs kyi yon tan du mas rgyan cing / rang rang gi gdul bya rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus na/ yon tan nor bu'i gdengs kas mtho zhing / legs bshad kyi phud sgra sgrog pa'i bstan 'dzin/ klu'i dbang po'i grangs kyi mtha' las 'das par bzhugs pa yin no/ /mdor na shar rgya nag dang 'dabs 'byar ba'i mdo khams nas/ nub phyogs kha che dang khad nye ba'i gu ge mang yul gyi bar byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'di yi mkhas pa dang grub thob/ /bla ma dang chos rje/ mkhan po dang gdan sa pa/ chen po dang slob dpon/ bshad nyan pa dang zur chos pa sogs lung rtogs kyi yon tan mthon po la bzhugs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal che ba rnams/ dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ dang po bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa nas/ mthar bstan pa'i bdag por ma gyur gyi bar du/ lugs gnyis kyi bka' drin chen pos nye bar bskyangs pa sha stag tu gnas pa yin no/ /de na gzu bo'i blos legs par dpyad na/ bdag nyid chen po 'di dang ming la mnyam yang don la mnyam pa su zhig yod/ de yang yul byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'dir/ thub bstan gsal bar mdzad pa'i mkhas grub chen po ji snyed cig byon pa de dag gi rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho lta bu mthong zhing thos mod kyang / rang nyid kyi shing rta'i srol phye nas thub bstan rmangs nas slang ba'i dar rgyas ji ltar mdzad pa'i ngo bo/ dus ji srid mdzad pa'i rgyun/ dus de nas ji srid du bar chad med par bshad sgrub lugs gnyis thad nas gong 'phel dang / je mthor gyur bas sku tshe mthar phyin pa 'di ni/
